summary: Iteration 45 - Complete testing of Room Finish Schedule 3D Shower View with new features: ceiling/floor as tileable surfaces, resizable wall zones with dimension labels, niche/bench/fixture placement, grout color selection, and tile orientation control. All 18 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified 3D perspective rendering, tile selection/placement, crop modal, pattern picker, and element placement modes.
critical_code_review_comments: 3D shower view renders correctly with CSS 3D perspective transforms (rotateY for side walls, rotateX for ceiling/floor)
Material palette shows 4 tile items with images at the top
Toolbar buttons exist: NEW, DIMS, NICHE, BENCH, FIXTURE, WALL
Tile selection shows green ring and 'SELECTED: [tile name] — click a zone to place as tile' message
Clicking zone opens crop modal with 'EXTRACT SINGLE TILE' title and canvas for drawing selection
Crop modal shows extracted tile preview with dimensions
CROP and PTN buttons appear on hover over zones with placed materials
Pattern picker panel shows 6 grout color buttons, orientation toggle (H/V), and 9 patterns
SIZE buttons on right edge of back wall open inline dimension input
NICHE MODE and BENCH MODE messages appear when respective toolbar buttons are clicked
Niche and bench elements are placed and visible on wall zones
Backend SurfaceEntry model has zone_config, niches, benches, fixtures fields with extra='allow'
PUT /api/projects/{id}/finish-schedules/{scheduleId} successfully saves all new fields
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo project with 4 tile items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 45 verified the complete 3D shower enclosure viewer with all new features. The 3D view uses CSS perspective transforms: rotateY(42deg) for left wall, rotateY(-42deg) for right wall, rotateX(58deg) for ceiling, rotateX(-52deg) for floor. Zone heights are configurable via zone_config array. Niches, benches, and fixtures are stored as arrays on each surface. The backend SurfaceEntry model was updated with class Config: extra='allow' and explicit optional fields. Pattern picker shows 9 patterns (stacked_horizontal, stacked_vertical, offset, one_third_offset, herringbone, herringbone_vertical, basket_weave, stepladder, diagonal). Grout colors: White, Light Gray, Gray, Brown, Charcoal, Black. Tile orientation: horizontal/vertical toggle.
